title: Status changes are one item per process

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
`done`, `park` and `unpark` each take exactly one positional id, and `set` takes one id.
Marking five items done is five processes, each doing a full `store.load` — which reads
every slice file — plus a full index rewrite and a log append.

For a human that is merely slow. For an agent closing out a batch it is five chances to
fail halfway with no transaction boundary.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Accept several ids: `slicer done S01 S02 S03`. Load once, mutate all, save once, one log
entry each. Same for `park`, `unpark` and `set`. Reading ids from stdin (`-`) would let
`slicer find ... --json | ... | slicer done -` compose.

**Not in this slice:** undo.
